1.title: Scan a worksheet
1.line: Pip scans a worksheet photo, lifts the ink, and lays out each question.

2.title: Parent review with flags
2.line: The parent checks flags and picks the right answers. The child never sees this page.

4.title: Mistake notebook and weak topics
4.line: Wrong questions land in a mistake notebook, ranked by weak topics.

5.title: Parent PIN, year group and print
